body.sql: SELECT Timestamp, ServiceName, SeverityText, Body FROM textbench WHERE positionCaseInsensitive(Body, 'failed order') > 0 AND ServiceName = 'checkout' AND Timestamp >= toDateTime64('2025-09-23 00:00:00.000', 3) AND Timestamp < toDateTime64('2025-09-23 00:30:00.000', 3) ORDER BY Timestamp DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT Timestamp, ServiceName, SeverityText, Body FROM textbench WHERE (positionCaseInsensitive(Body, 'connection reset') > 0 OR positionCaseInsensitive(Body, 'timeout') > 0) AND ServiceName = 'frontend' AND SeverityNumber >= 13 AND Timestamp >= toDateTime64('2025-09-23 00:00:00.000', 3) AND Timestamp < toDateTime64('2025-09-23 00:30:00.000', 3) ORDER BY Timestamp DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT Timestamp, ServiceName, SeverityText, Body FROM textbench WHERE multiSearchAnyCaseInsensitive(Body, ['error', 'exception', 'failed', 'timeout', 'refused']) = 1 ORDER BY Timestamp DESC LIMIT 100;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM textbench WHERE positionCaseInsensitive(Body, 'timeout') > 0;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM textbench WHERE multiSearchAnyCaseInsensitive(Body, ['error', 'exception', 'failed', 'timeout', 'refused']) = 1;
SELECT ServiceName, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM textbench WHERE multiSearchAnyCaseInsensitive(Body, ['exception', 'timeout', 'failed']) = 1 GROUP BY ServiceName ORDER BY cnt DESC;
SELECT ServiceName, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM textbench WHERE positionCaseInsensitive(Body, 'connection') > 0 AND positionCaseInsensitive(Body, 'reset') > 0 GROUP BY ServiceName ORDER BY cnt DESC;
SELECT toStartOfHour(Timestamp) AS hour, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM textbench WHERE positionCaseInsensitive(Body, 'payment') > 0 AND ServiceName = 'checkout' GROUP BY hour ORDER BY hour;

SELECT toStartOfHour(Timestamp) AS hour, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM textbench WHERE positionCaseInsensitive(Body, 'connection') > 0 AND positionCaseInsensitive(Body, 'reset') > 0 GROUP BY hour ORDER BY hour;

SELECT ServiceName, COUNT(*) AS cnt, uniqExact(TraceId) AS unique_traces FROM textbench WHERE multiSearchAnyCaseInsensitive(Body, ['exception', 'timeout', 'failed']) = 1 GROUP BY ServiceName ORDER BY cnt DESC;
